titulo: Ante = before, in front of, faced with
subtitulo: Declaró ante el juez. Ante la duda, pregunta.
regla: Ante is a formal preposition for place, not time: before, in the presence of (ante un juez, ante notario). It also means faced with, in the face of (ante la crisis, ante la duda). Ante todo = above all. For time, use antes de.

lista.forma: ante = before, in the presence of
lista.texto: **ante el juez, ante notario, ante el público**. More formal than **enfrente de / delante de**.

lista.forma: ante = faced with, in the face of
lista.texto: **ante la crisis, ante la falta de pruebas, ante tanta presión**.
_above all, first and foremost_: **ante todo, calma**.

bloques.texto: Tip: **ante** = standing face to face with someone or something.

lista.es: Rodrigo tuvo que presentarse ==ante un juez== para declarar.
lista.en: Rodrigo had to appear before a judge to give a statement.

lista.es: Tienes que firmar los papeles ==ante notario== para que sean válidos.
lista.en: You have to sign the papers before a notary for them to be valid.

lista.es: Los manifestantes se plantaron ==ante el Palacio Nacional==.
lista.en: The protesters stood in front of the National Palace.

lista.es: ==Ante la imposibilidad== de reclamar, buscó un abogado.
lista.en: Faced with no way to file a claim, he got a lawyer.
First of all, thank you for coming.

bloques.texto: Say it out loud, then open the answer.

lista.p: In Spanish (formal): _He swore before the judge._
In Spanish: _In the face of the emergency, they evacuated._
In Spanish: _Before dinner, wash your hands._
lista.r: Antes de cenar, lávate las manos.
